World.title: JICA and the World Bank should put the poor first
World.content:
The last 75 years have brought the greatest improvement of human welfare in history. But over the past decade, much of that progress has stalled. This happened at the same time that the rich world shifted its attention to climate change. This is not a coincidence and it has to change.

Consider extreme poverty, long defined as living on less than a dollar a day. In 1950, more than half of humanity was that poor. Today the share is 7.6%, the lowest ever recorded. Average schooling has almost tripled, from 3.2 years to nearly 9. Electricity access has soared. Problems remain, but the gains have been spectacular.

Now development has slowed to a crawl. After almost two centuries of declining poverty, the number of poor people hasn’t budged since 2016. Global progress is at its slowest pace since 1950, according to the World Bank.

World.title: Asian Para Games officially open in Nagoya
World.content:
The opening ceremony of the first Japan-hosted Asian Para Games took place at Paloma Mizuho Stadium in Nagoya on Sunday, officially marking the start of the 2026 Games.

About 3,000 athletes from 45 countries and regions are scheduled to participate. The Japanese delegation has entered about 280 athletes.

At the opening ceremony, Japanese Emperor Naruhito declared the opening of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games. The ceremony was also attended by Crown Prince Akishino, the honorary president of the Games, and Crown Princess Kiko.

Japanese Para alpine skier Momoka Muraoka and others served as the final torchbearers. Japanese wheelchair tennis player Tokito Oda and others took the athletes’ oath.

Following the Asian Games, which concluded on Oct. 4, a total of 18 sports will be contested in Aichi and neighboring Shizuoka Prefecture through Saturday.

The Japanese delegation aims to break its record medal haul of 198, set at the 2018 Games in Jakarta.

The Asian Para Games are the successor to FESPIC (Far East and South Pacific Games for the Disabled). The first FESPIC Games were held in Oita Prefecture, southwestern Japan, in 1975. The first Asian Para Games were held in 2010, and this is the 5th Asian Para Games.

World.title: [Update 2] Report on Unauthorized Access to Group Managed Server and Potential Data Leak
World.content:
The Japan Times, Ltd. and News2u Holdings, Inc. (Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo; hereinafter “our Group“) hereby provide an update on the progress of the investigation and monitoring being conducted in cooperation with external specialized organizations regarding the unauthorized access to our Group managed server, originally announced by The Japan Times, Ltd. on October 2, 2026.

1. Overview

On September 18, 2026, we confirmed that a server managed by our Group was subjected to a cyberattack using ransomware. Subsequently, on October 15, we confirmed that data claimed by the attacker to have been exfiltrated from our Group was published on an external website.

2. Information Potentially at Risk of Exposure

Preliminary investigations indicate that the affected server was an administrative file server utilized by our Group until August 2022. The published data may include HR-related information and business partner information of our Group covering the period from 2001 to August 2022.

Please note that this server does not contain any data from August 2022 onward. Furthermore, digital services operated by The Japan Times, Ltd., including “The Japan Times Online,” subscriber databases, and payment systems, are operated on independent infrastructure.

3. Actions Taken by Our Group

Immediately upon discovery, our Group implemented emergency measures, including isolating the affected server. Currently, with the support of multiple external specialized organizations, we are cross-referencing the published data while continuing security measures such as log monitoring. The specific content and scope of the information included in the published data have not yet been fully identified. In addition, we continue to provide preliminary and ongoing reports in accordance with relevant laws and regulations to the Personal Information Protection Commission, the police department with jurisdiction, and other relevant authorities.

As the facts are clarified through our ongoing investigation, we will individually contact business partners and individuals whose information is confirmed to be contained in the published data. For those whose contact information cannot be verified, inquiries will be handled through the contact point below.

4. Request to Prevent Secondary Damage

Should you receive any suspicious emails or communications pretending to be from our Group or related parties, please refrain from accessing any embedded URLs or opening any attached files.

We sincerely apologize for the considerable concern and inconvenience this incident may cause to all stakeholders. If you have any concerns or questions regarding this matter, please contact us at the address below.

Inquiries Regarding This Matter
